conflict_flags.resolution_chosen: 2400 SF (Building 8221 Scope.docx, Contract SOW, Brown Electric email — three sources agree)
conflict_flags.rationale: The 40'x60' footprint from the scope document yields exactly 2,400 SF and is confirmed by the executed contract SOW and the electrical subconsultant correspondence. The BOD's '+/- 2466' likely represents a rounded design estimate; the fire protection BOD's '~2500' is a further conservative rounding. All three values are within 5% of each other (minor severity). The 2,400 SF figure is used as it is most precisely corroborated.
